title: PM-KISAN Bihar – किसान आवेदन और स्थिति
vacancyDetails: PM-KISAN registration, beneficiary status, e-KYC and installment-related services for Bihar farmers.
qualification: Eligible farmer families as per PM-KISAN guidelines.
applicationFee: No application fee on the official PM-KISAN portal.
selectionProcess: Registration -> Eligibility and land verification -> e-KYC -> Installment release
documentsRequired: Aadhaar, mobile number, bank account and land or farmer details as required by the official portal.
howToApply: Open the official PM-KISAN portal, use New Farmer Registration or Beneficiary Status, enter the required details and complete e-KYC.
shortDescription: PM-KISAN Bihar services for farmer registration, application, beneficiary status and installment updates.
content:
Bihar farmers can use the official PM-KISAN portal for new registration, beneficiary status, e-KYC and installment-related information.

Use the portal to check beneficiary details, payment status and required farmer information before submitting an application.

Always verify eligibility, land records, bank details and e-KYC requirements through the official government portal before relying on an installment update.
